b: Seymour Duncan has introduced the Custom Strat Limited Edition 50th Anniversary Custom Shop Set.

Limited to 500 sets, each is hand-built by the elite Custom Shop team led by Maricela "MJ" Juarez, the "queen of tone," with craftsmen who have been part of the Seymour Duncan family for decades. The set includes two vintage-voiced SSL-1 pickups paired with the hotter SSL-5 bridge, all hand-built with commemorative details, lightly aged appointments, replica labels, exclusive packaging, and a Certificate of Authenticity signed by Seymour and MJ.

Signed and Authenticated: Includes a Certificate of Authenticity signed by Seymour Duncan and MJ, plus original replica "Seymourized" stickers and replica model name stickers just like the earliest ones

First-Ever Combined Set: The popular pairing of two SSL-1 Vintage Staggered Strat pickups (with an RWRP middle for hum-canceling in positions 2 and 4) and an SSL-5 Custom Staggered Strat bridge, offered together as one set for the first time
Vintage Construction: Built exactly as the originals, with hand-filed Forbon V-shaped flatwork, period-correct magnet stagger, wax-potted lacquered bobbins, and chamfered magnets
Exclusive Anniversary Packaging: Special commemorative packaging, and lightly aged white covers, celebrate 50 years of Seymour Duncan's tone and craftsmanship.
Seymour Duncan’s Custom Strat Limited Edition 50th Anniversary Custom Shop Set is available for a street price of $375. For more information, visit seymourduncan.com.
